## History

Gracie is a village woman in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) who participates in local gossip following the end of Anne's two-year term as the schoolteacher. She discusses the future of the town, the deep affection Anne's pupils have for her, and the unexpected arrival of [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P2](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0002), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P3](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0003), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P4](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0004), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P5](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0005), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P7](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0007), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P8](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0008), +33 more_

## Relationships

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gracie--paul-irving.md)

[Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) is Gracie's childhood crush, who courts her by bringing her flowers and carrying her schoolbooks. Their relationship is marked by these sweet, youthful romantic gestures during their time together in school.
